_comment: Copy to proxy_config.json and customize. proxy_config.json is gitignored.

security._comment_config_auth_enabled: Set to true to require API key for /v1/context/config endpoints
security._comment_config_api_key_env: Name of env var containing the API key (e.g., CONFIG_API_KEY)

context._comment_enable_token_calculation: Set to false to disable dynamic token counting
context._comment_max_message_content_size_kb: Max size of a single message content for token calc (KB)
context._comment_max_total_content_size_kb: Max total content size for token calc (KB)

upstream._comment_timeout: Base timeout in seconds for upstream model calls (default: 1800 = 30 min). Or set PROXY_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT env var.
upstream._comment_timeout_multiplier: Scale timeout by this factor for large/complex prompts (>50KB or >20 messages). Or set PROXY_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MULTIPLIER env var.
upstream._comment_retry_max_attempts: Max retries on transient connection errors (ChunkedEncodingError, ConnectionReset). 0 to disable retry.
upstream._comment_retry_base_delay: Initial backoff delay in seconds (doubles each retry up to retry_max_delay).
upstream._comment_endpoint_concurrency: Max concurrent in-flight requests per endpoint origin. Key = scheme://host:port, value = int. Omitted endpoints are unlimited.
